settings.content:
### 🏛️ Executive Enterprise AI Operations Center

Welcome to the unified operations, telemetry, and governance dashboard for **Foundry Responsible Agent Sentinel** and **Repo Watchdog Agent**.

* **Azure AI Foundry Hub & Project:** Autonomous agent grounded in Azure AI Search with strict multi-point Responsible AI (RAI) prompt shields.
* **Cognitive Compute:** GPT-4o orchestration with Text-Embedding-3-Large vectors.
* **Perimeter Watchdog:** Rolling 24-hour upstream dependency telemetry, automated diff inspection, and breaking-change detection.

---

settings.title: 📦 Compute & Storage Cost Optimization Guide
settings.subtitle: Financial Governance & Resource Tier Sizing
settings.content:
### 💡 Cost & Sizing Breakdown

* **Azure AI Foundry:** Serverless consumption model — billed per token input/output for GPT-4o and Text-Embedding-3.
* **Azure AI Search (Basic/Standard):** Dedicated Search Units (SU) provide deterministic vector queries and semantic ranking (~$75/mo base for Basic).
* **Azure Blob Storage (LRS):** Negligible storage footprint (< $1/mo) with Hot tier data access.
* **Key Vault:** Zero-trust secrets with per-operation billing (< $0.50/mo).
* **Sentinel Runner:** Zero compute cost (runs on free GitHub Actions tier & local systemd node).
